segments.text: In 2024, voice AI crossed a threshold that used to sound like science fiction.
That threshold was Kokoro. And it changed everything.
Mica Reynolds walked through Reykjavik while recording narration for this series.
NASA released the weights while CIA briefings mentioned synthetic audio.
Misaki turns graphemes into phonemes before UnfoldIQ renders a video.
The rest of this series explains how each piece works.
